title: Hearty Wood-Fired Kenyan Seafood Bake
description: A rich, velvety, festive Kenyan dish perfect for special occasions, featuring a frozen seafood mix cooked in a wood-fired kazan. This recipe is sugar-free friendly and can be served as a main course or special treat.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince or crush for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat coconut milk for best flavor and texture.

ingredients.name: Curry Powder
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for desired level of heat.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked or sweet paprika for added depth.

instructions: Preheat your wood-fired kazan to 4006 F (2006 C).
Prepare the seafood mix according to package instructions, or thaw and rinse under cold water if frozen.
In a large bowl, mix together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, curry powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the thawed seafood mix to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the seafood mix to the preheated kazan and pour in the coconut milk.
Brush the sides of the kazan with coconut oil to prevent sticking.
Cover the kazan with a lid or foil and bake for 12 minutes, or until the seafood is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Let the kazan cool slightly before serving, as it will be extremely hot.
Consider serving with a side of rice, naan, or roti for a filling meal.
Feel free to adjust the spice level to your liking by adding more or less curry powder.
This recipe makes 4-6 servings and can be prepared in about 20 minutes.
Total cooking time, including prep, is approximately 45 minutes.
